Reisen Udongein Inaba: Reisen is a 55 year old female Moon Rabbit from the world of Gensokyo. She is described as changing her personality completely to match her circumstances. Ordinarily timid and sometimes showing a scatterbrained side, she can be both carefree and crazed, and is a different person in battle. Formerly, Reisen was a moon rabbit in service of the Lunarians, as the pet of the sisters Watatsuki no Toyohime and Watatsuki no Yorihime, and being enlisted in the Lunar Defense Corps. Moon rabbits are used for a large variety of menial labor including farming, pounding medicine, cleaning and as soldiers in the Lunar Capital's war effort. However, sometime in the Lunar War, Reisen deserted the Lunar Capital and fled to Earth as refugee from the "Lunar War" between the two worlds that began in 1969 A.D. after the Apollo 11 "invasion". After seeking refuge from Eientei, Reisen now serves Eirin Yagokoro and Kaguya Houraisan. She effectively performs as their servant, doing manual errands and taking charge of festival preparations for them. Eirin serves as Reisen's master as well as her mentor in medicines. Eirin also sends her to the Human Village as a medicine peddler. They operates under an okigusuri system, where each customer is given a medicine box, which is check at the turn of the season, and only the medicine used is charged for. In addition, Reisen commands Tewi Inaba, who herself commands all of the earth rabbits of Gensokyo. However, Reisen complains that Tewi does not listen to her, leaving her to attend to chores and cleaning up by herself. Reisen has abilities such as Lunacy-inducing eyes, Telepathy with other Moon Rabbits, Manipulation of Wavelengths (Soundwaves and Lightwaves), Manipulation of Madness.
Reisen has red eyes, long light-purple hair and long rumpled rabbit ears - like all members of the Lunar Defense Corps her ears stand up straight and are decorated with two accoutrement-like buttons, she also possesses modified gigantic tits which are as big as her body. All that Reisen wears are white sock and a pink skirt.

Reysen has short blue hair, and red eyes, modified gigantic tits which are as big as her body. She wears only a beige skirt and nothing else. She has white lop rabbit ears, lacking the button-like decorations normally worn by other members of the Lunar Defense Corps.

Ringo: Ringo is a 55 year old female Moon Rabbit from the world of Gensokyo. Ringo is an individual who prefers to be alone and away from the public's attention. She can be friendly to people that interest her, even if they are enemies. After losing, she commends her opponent's strengths and tells them where to go. She expresses a desire to live on Earth. Since she liked Earth so much, Ringo decided to desert the Moon and stay in Gensokyo, where she owns a Dango stand these days. She has abilities such as Growing in strength by eating Dango. She is a member of the "Eagle Ravi" Earth Recon Unit, and along with other members, she was sent to "purify" the Earth. However, she takes no direct role in this as her job is more leisurely; she is in charge of Information Management, which is considered a high-ranking job in the Lunarian Military. Despite being highly ranked, she had no info on why the Lunar Capital was relocated to the Dream World, she assumes that she would've been dealt with had she found out.
Ringo has red eyes and short blonde hair, and two short, drooping rabbit's ears. Ringo also has modified gigantic tits which are as big as her body. All that Ringo wears are yellow patterned pumpkin breeches, and a brown patterned newsboy cap.

Seiran: Seiran is a 55 year old female Moon Rabbit from the world of Gensokyo. She has problems holding a regular conversation, even with her Moon Rabbit comrades, implying that she's either shy or doesn't get much respect from her fellow moon rabbits. Seiran was a member of the "Eagle Ravi" Earth Recon Unit sent to "purify" the Earth and is part of the Lunarian Military Infiltrators. She's in charge of the Infiltration operations, one of the most dangerous jobs. Seiran doesn't get much respect, being treated as cannon fodder. No reinforcements come to her aid and would've been slain if she blurted out the location of her base. She doesn't get paid much despite the risks. After the events of Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom she abandons the Moon and came to Gensokyo, now being a Dango salesgirl. After staying on Earth for some years, Seiran became an Earth-loving Moon Rabbit. Seiran spends much of her time praising Earth, and stating Earth is full of impurity and excitement. However, she has a dislike for the impurity of germs and especially the scent of death. she struggles to handle the scent of death related characters and hell itself, but with the encouragement of Saki Kurokoma Seiran learned to briefly handle even the impurity of Hell itself and return home. She has abilities such as Firing bullets from other dimensions. Seiran possesses a hammer-shaped pounding mallet, which she uses to pound mochi as well as fire danmaku. It's unknown if she could also use it as a melee weapon. She also possesses a Moon Jewel capable of removing impurities such as dirt and bacteria. It is implied that this is a standard issue item for Moon Rabbits.
Seiran expresses negative opinions for both people on the Moon and being reminded of the Lunar Capital, getting depressed whenever she is reminded of it. She mentions in a dialogue with Zanmu Nippaku that she prefers how Hell Oni do things more energetically over Lunarians, and tells Yachie Kicchou that the Moon is full of crafty people like her.
Seiran has dark blue hair, tied in two bushy ponytails, with ears similar to Reisen Udongein Inaba's on the top of her head and an accessory in one of them, she has red eyes, a common trait in Moon Rabbits. Seiran also possesses modified gigantic tits which are as big as her body. All that Seiran wears are white socks and a blue skirt with frills and an alternating star and crescent moon pattern across the bottom.
